summary: Discord music autoplay: when the queue empties, Nora seeds a YouTube Mix recommendation instead of going idle.
details: New [music] autoplay_enabled config flag (default false; on for this deployment). When on, MusicPlayer._advance seeds ONE track from TrackSource.related() -- YouTube's own 'Mix' recommendations for whatever just finished -- before falling back to the existing idle-timeout behaviour.

TrackSource gained a related(locator) method, implemented for YtDlpSource via YouTube's well-known list=RD<video_id> Mix trick, flat-extracted like an ordinary playlist and with the Mix's own seed track filtered out.

An autoplayed track is enqueued through the same MusicQueueStore.enqueue every /music play uses -- no second mutation path -- and is announced as 'Autoplaying: <title>' rather than 'Now playing:' so it's clear nobody requested it.
limitations: One track at a time, reseeded from whatever most recently played -- not a multi-track lookahead queue.
No per-guild opt-out; today it is one deployment-wide flag like every other [music] setting.
